tracks.question: How strongly does exact prompt text change fixed-seed H3 output in each conditioning family?

evidence.claim: Official ComfyUI passes prompt text and ordered images or reference items into the H3 Qwen tokenizer.

next_actions: Run the Stage-1 FL2VA prompt-form screen with one fixed seed.
Confirm that exact prompt bytes differ in receipts and that outputs are not identical.

tracks.question: Can FL2VA language reliably distinguish focal-length change, camera translation and recursive spatial traversal?

evidence.claim: The official guide defines zoom and push as physically different camera operations.
Recent case studies repeatedly attribute better transitions to continuous physical path descriptions rather than static destination descriptions.

next_actions: Measure parallax and apparent scale trajectories for all three fixed-seed variants.
Repeat only the two geometrically distinguishable variants across three seeds.

tracks.question: Can natural-language timing shape velocity and terminal landing rather than only broad event order?

evidence.claim: The public prompt guide requires requested duration and exact shot timing to agree.

next_actions: Compare optical-flow velocity curves for uniform, accelerating and accelerate-then-land prompts.
Inspect the final second separately for early landing, hold and reset behavior.

tracks.question: Which language reaches the last frame with coherent incoming motion instead of landing early, dissolving or snapping?
next_actions: Score last-frame pixels and the preceding 24-frame motion window independently.
Retain no wording from a single successful seed without repeat evidence.

tracks.question: How do Ref2VA labels, roles and retention markers divide authority over appearance, motion and whole-video structure?

evidence.claim: The official Ref2VA guide specifies six ordered sections and distinct roles for Subject, Picture and Video labels.

next_actions: Compare flat and six-section prompts with one fixed motion-reference video.
Only after that, isolate retention marker strength and reference count.

tracks.question: Does text determine what H3 synthesizes between target-time AddGuide states once placement is fixed?

evidence.claim: Dense target-time AddGuide expansion has executed locally at 2x and 3x with positive operator review.
Qwen-only timed references were rejected as a replacement for target-aligned AddGuide states.

next_actions: Re-use one accepted guide ladder and vary only the prompt relation.
Evaluate distinct intermediate motion, freezes, echoes and anchor fidelity.

tracks.question: When prompt and Fun Control agree or conflict, which signal controls motion and structure?

evidence.claim: Canny and depth Fun Control graphs execute locally, while visual promotion remains pending.

next_actions: Choose one visually useful control carrier before testing language authority.
Keep carrier, strength and interval fixed across neutral, congruent and conflicting prompts.

tracks.question: Do retained prompt effects survive Turbo or PDD acceleration and quantized H3 variants?

evidence.claim: The fixed-input quality-20, Turbo and PDD execution profiles are technically characterized.

next_actions: Screen cheaply on one fixed acceleration profile.
Confirm the two best prompt variants on quality-20 before promotion.
Declare any profile-specific behavior explicitly.

tracks.question: When does additional causal detail improve control, and when does it introduce competing motion or timing instructions?

evidence.claim: The official Ref2VA guide recommends highly detailed generation descriptions, while official ComfyUI templates also demonstrate much shorter direct prompts.

next_actions: Compare information structure rather than raw character count.
Count independent requested motions and temporal clauses per prompt.

tracks.question: How does L2VA infer a plausible past, and which FL2VA arrival techniques transfer without assuming time reversibility?

evidence.claim: The public guide treats L2VA as plausible preceding state, explicit transition path, gradual convergence and last-frame landing.

next_actions: Declare a dedicated L2VA matrix after Stage-1 FL2VA vocabulary has repeat evidence.

tracks.question: Do official learned prompt embeddings alter style without degrading motion path or endpoint fidelity?

evidence.claim: ComfyUI supports embedding syntax for MiniMax H3 and its official template references downloadable style embeddings.

next_actions: Test one embedding only after a plain-text FL2VA motion baseline is repeat-supported.

tracks.question: Can an external prompt rewriter improve repeatable H3 control beyond direct human-authored structured prompts?

evidence.claim: Several new nodepacks offer local or API-backed H3 prompt expansion, auditing and repair, but none is project evidence.

next_actions: Do not install a rewriter until the direct prompt response surface is characterized.
Later compare exact rewriter output against its unexpanded brief with fixed media and seeds.

radar.watch: Prompt guide commits, model cards, reproducible requests, issues with maintainer confirmation and new released capabilities.
Conditioning contracts, reference ordering, AddGuide, masks, Fun Control, memory fixes and prompt-token behavior.
Canonical graph topology, prompt examples, supported models, acceleration profiles and prompt embeddings.
New integrations and nodepacks; inspect mechanism and code before considering installation.
New prompt case studies, validators and rewriters; retain claims as hypotheses unless controlled evidence is available.
New native conditioning, control, continuation and editing mechanisms; reject arbitrary sampler hacks without mechanism evidence.
Architecture-compatible conditioning, reference binding, temporal completion and evaluation methods; do not assume direct H3 portability.
